Haque, B. and Lamboo, S. (2023). Energy efficiency options in the Dutch manufacturing industry. MIDDEN report, PBL publication number 5256, TNO 2023 P11389. The Hague: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency and TNO Energy & Material Transition. 31 August 2023. www.pbl.nl/en

Measure catalogue: sector energy-efficiency measures (Tables 3-14 and text) and the P6-25 technical potentials by sector and technology (Table 20) go to _measures.csv (not loaded). Loaded into the main file only whole-technology parameters: the Appendix A conversion assumptions (Table 18: HT heat pump COP 4, MVR COP 7.5, gas boiler 90%, electric boiler 99%), heat pump TRL by delivery temperature (s.1.2, reprinted from Maruf et al. 2022) and gas/diesel vs electric compressor efficiencies (s.3.8.5, reprinted). Not loaded (in _other-values): emission factors, sector energy use and potentials (Tables 1, 2, 15, 17, 19), glass wool 17.3 TJ/kt and steel 52.2 PJ for 7.05 Mt (reprinted from MIDDEN sector reports already in the MIDDEN database). No costs, lifetimes or capacities are printed.

(1) Savings are expressed inconsistently (share of sector energy 2030 vs 2020, share of a process step, PJ, GJ/t, TJ/kt), so they cannot be compared without the underlying MIDDEN energy balances. (2) Section numbering skips 3.2 and repeats 3.8.4 (building materials and food). (3) Refinery energy use given as 168.3 PJ in the text (p.26) but 128.3 PJ in Tables 1 and 17. (4) Fertilizer P6-25 potential given as 2.9 PJ (Tables 1 and 17), 3.5 PJ (Table 16) and 3.6 PJ (text p.42). (5) Overlap correction total printed as -39.6 (Table 16) and -39.4 (Table 20). (6) Table 18 COPs and efficiencies are calculation assumptions, not measured; heating-value basis not stated. (7) Glass wool: '17.3 TJ energy use per kt ... total estimated energy use if 1 PJ' (typo; 60 kt x 17.3 TJ/kt).
